response: In ward G/S (Worli, Lower Parel, Prabhadevi), contractors billed Rs 2821986 for monsoon road repairs against a budget of Rs 3200000, or 88.2 percent, across 64 jobs. Within 30 days, 32.8 percent of jobs were reopened, and 56.2 percent met their deadline. Weather likely played a part. The city had 18 days of heavy or worse rain, and this low-lying ward (index 0.6) floods often. Still, Rs 1059034 was billed on DLP roads. DLP means the road is still under the original contractor's warranty, so repairs should cost the city nothing. That amount needs review. No jobs exceeded the 30 percent rate card tolerance. The top contractor by spend was Sahyadri Infra Works (synthetic). No work order IDs were provided for this ward. A ward officer can ask which DLP roads were billed and why the warranty contractor was not called to fix them.
